profile.headline: Seasoned Fullstack Engineer | Typescript/Javascript Specialist
profile.summary:
I strive to inspire everyone I meet to be the best version of themselves.

I'm a veteran Fullstack (frontend leaning) software engineer with over a decade of experience. Leveraging TypeScript and cloud technologies, I specialize in developing interactive experiences that resonate with audiences, enhance brand identities, and meet end-user needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-architected and shipped multiple Consumer Electronics Experiences for Walmart, Ashley Furniture, Samsung, and Huntington Bank for various trade shows (High Point Market, CES 2026) and in-store use cases.

Served as technical lead on QR Remote Control, taking a hackathon MVP to production by implementing all backend API routes in Go, designing a Firebase-backed guest auth system, and pioneering the org's first feature flag segmentation use case.

Co-led P0 outage resolution for custom built Pricing application for Lucky Strike alongside the CTO, catching a critical logic error in the emergency fix PR; authored post-mortem documentation and a hardening plan that prevented recurrence.

Helped develop and launch the Rockbot Smart Amp product — defined the peripheral API contract, built the operator UI with optimistic updates, and coordinated a sequenced cross-repo rollout across three codebases and multiple teams.

Established engineering standards across the org: unified Vue 2/3 feature flag paradigm, authored the team's first unified frontend style guide, improved observability with Rollbar session replays, and introduced the client-side NATS implementation for real-time event-driven communication.
positions.insights: Skills: go · TypeScript · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Vue.js · React · brightsign

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Providing freelance/contract software development services, specializing in frontend technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: Three.js · React · React Native · Cloudflare · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Node.js · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Software Development · Web Development

positions.title: Senior Creative Developer
positions.description:
Led front-end projects end-to-end, effectively communicating with leadership and other engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable code.

Worked closely with designers and back-end developers to ensure cohesive app and website functionality for agency clients.

Developed and launched a variety of web and mobile applications (using technologies such as Three.js, React, React-Native, and Vue), adhering to accessibility and browser compatibility standards, including:
- Tech support app for the elderly. (React Native)
- Various Marketing sites. (React, Three.js)
- Educational game for children. (React, Three.js) sos.fbi.gov
- Agency website. Created a custom Vite workflow for deploying custom JS to Webflow. (Webflow, React, Three.js)  triptych.co
- North Carolina Museum of Art Exhibit: Interactive Samurai Armor Configurator. A Threejs.js powered touch screen experience that allowed users to configure samurai armor sets and generate a battle survivability score

positions.title: Front-End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and maintaining the front end code for all Fundraising Team products and other customer facing tools, ensuring they deliver a seamless and engaging experience for customers.

Spearheaded the creation of Qgiv’s React-powered donation forms, integrating seamlessly with a PHP back end. Directed code reviews for a team of three engineers.

As an individual contributor, built out a “virtual terminal” admin panel using existing platform patterns. This terminal allowed admins to monitor products/seats/bids for Qgiv’s Auction product.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Crafted user-friendly and audience appropriate web experiences utilizing Javascript, CSS, & HTML.

Built out custom forms and email signature generators.

Implemented comprehensive testing and bug-fixing protocols, decreasing site downtime and enhancing overall reliability.

Involved in the creative process of generating brand identities, marketing systems, and advertising campaigns.
